mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shop_orders WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM shop_orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE i.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT o.* FROM shop_orders o WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id AND i.merchant_id=#{merchantId})
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,actor_id,event_type,from_status,to_status,detail,trigger_source,scheduled_task_id,created_at FROM order_events WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT status FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId}
SELECT customer_id FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId}
SELECT i.id AS order_item_id,i.product_id FROM order_items i JOIN shop_orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.id=#{itemId} AND o.customer_id=#{customerId} AND o.status IN ('RECEIVED','COMPLETED')
SELECT payload_fingerprint,response_payload FROM order_remote_message_inbox WHERE message_id=#{mutationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_remote_message_inbox SET processing_status='APPLIED',response_payload=#{response}, processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE message_id=#{mutationId}
UPDATE shop_orders SET logistics_delivered_at=COALESCE(logistics_delivered_at,#{occurredAt}), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('SHIPPED','RECEIVED','COMPLETED')
UPDATE shop_orders SET status=#{toStatus},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=#{fromStatus}
UPDATE shop_orders SET inventory_status=#{toStatus},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND inventory_status=#{fromStatus}
UPDATE shop_orders SET inventory_status='WAITING_COMMIT',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND inventory_status IN ('RESERVED','WAITING_RESERVATION')
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='CANCELLING',cancel_reason=#{reason},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CANCELLING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='PAID',cancel_reason=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CANCELLING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='PAID',cancelled_at=NULL, cancel_reason='Recovered after late successful payment',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CANCELLED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='RECEIVED',received_at=#{occurredAt},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='SHIPPED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=#{occurredAt},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='RECEIVED'

UPDATE shop_orders SET status='CONFIRMED',confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='PAID' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items WHERE order_id=shop_orders.id AND merchant_id=#{actorId})

UPDATE shop_orders SET status='SHIPPED',carrier=#{carrier},tracking_number=#{trackingNumber}, shipped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND inventory_status='COMMITTED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items WHERE order_id=shop_orders.id AND merchant_id=#{actorId})
UPDATE shop_orders SET carrier=#{carrier},tracking_number=#{trackingNumber},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='SHIPPED'
